bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $370.7，测试 $360

read.en: Rockwell fell 5.5% on Nov 20 to $361.93, its lowest close since Mar 31, trading $360.47–383.10. It is below the 5-day ($383.4), 10-day ($391.6), 30-day ($416.1), 100-day ($435.8) and 200-day ($425.6), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($425.14), and RSI is 31.9, down from 42.3 five sessions ago.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 11月20日下跌 5.5%，收于 $361.93，为 3月31日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $360.47–383.10。股价位于 5 日（$383.4）、10 日（$391.6）、30 日（$416.1）、100 日（$435.8）和 200 日均线（$425.6）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$425.14），RSI 为 31.9，五个交易日前为 42.3。

read.en: The drop broke the $370.7–377 supports (Nov 5 and 6 lows), now resistance, and held just above the $360 round number. Resistance is $363.9–371.7 (Nov 6 low, Mar 25 and Apr 1 highs), then $375–378.3 and $383–383.4 (Nov 20 high, 5-day). Support is $358.9–360.9 ($360, Mar 31 close), then $354–357.4 and $347.5 (52-week low). A close above $371.7 would target $375–378; below $358.9, $354–357.
